name: mini-displayport
description: A Mini DisplayPort socket with a wide keyed opening.
useCase: Identify a Mini DisplayPort connection on a computer or display.
misuse: Pair this icon with a visible label when identifying a connection.

16.reason: A wide mouth and two upper bevels remain distinct from the near-square Type-B socket. The central tongue stays separated from the outline.

24.reason: The wider keyed outline keeps both upper bevels and clear space around the central tongue.
